# BigQuery emulator on DuckDB vs goccy

**Reviewed: 2026-10-20.** This comparison helps developers choose a local BigQuery test environment. This project's main value is its broader **local service behavior**: executable ML, external tables and federation, policy enforcement, snapshots, clones, and richer metadata alongside analytical SQL.

Both projects use a GoogleSQL frontend. goccy also implements substantial SQL, scripting, UDF and Storage API functionality. An analyzer, a backend's function list, or a green catalog check alone does not establish complete BigQuery compatibility.

- **This emulator:** source package 0.1.4, DuckDB 1.5.6, GoogleSQL 2026.9.2; catalog inspected at local revision `479797bc`. See the [README](../README.md) for runtime and packaging requirements.
- **goccy:** [source revision `cb8555bee739`](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/tree/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a), requiring [googlesqlite v0.3.1](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/blob/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a/go.mod#L14). The dependency was inspected at [revision `36f6275991c0`](https://github.com/goccy/googlesqlite/tree/36f6275991c003cde752014fa886eae33df6615d).

[Every catalogued feature](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md) · [Filterable feature CSV](comparison-features.csv) · [Document reconciliation](COMPARISON_RECONCILIATION.md)

## Side-by-side features

**√** = implemented within the cited scope; **△** = partial; **×** = explicitly unsupported; **?** = unassessed. goccy cells describe source or published support, not a new test run. See the detailed matrix's **S / D / B** evidence labels. These high-level areas summarize the individual rows below; do not count each area as an extra feature.

| Feature area | This emulator | goccy | What this means for developers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Query execution | GoogleSQL → Python semantic compiler → DuckDB | GoogleSQL → googlesqlite → SQLite | Different execution backends; this document makes no general speedup claim. |
| SQL functions and types | √ Bounded contracts, with explicit gaps | √ Broad backend spec coverage | Inspect [individual functions and types](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql--function); neither side gets a blanket SQL parity tick. |
| Scripting and stored procedures | √ Documented local forms | √ Documented, subject to backend coverage | goccy is not limited to `IF`. [Upstream SQL surface](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/blob/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a/docs/feature-support.md#L196). |
| Materialized views, table functions and recursive CTEs | √ Local contracts | √ Documented / backend specs | These are shared capabilities; this emulator's materialized views read fresh data without a managed refresh scheduler. [View contract](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.ddl.create-materialized-view). |
| BigQuery ML model creation | △ Supported model families and inputs | × `CREATE MODEL` absent | Train local models with the [documented model-type limits](FEATURE_PARITY_GAPS.md); do not claim all BQML. [Comparison](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.create-model). |
| ML prediction, evaluation and weights | √ Local model execution | × ML execution absent | Test model workflows beyond metadata stubs. Each function has [its own matrix row](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.ml-predict). |
| Generative text and embedding functions | √ With configured compatible provider | × ML execution absent | Exercise provider-backed SQL calls; a reachable provider is required. [Text](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.ml-generate-text) / [embedding](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.ml-generate-embedding). |
| External file tables and SQL federation | √ Emulated GCS tables; configured SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL federation | × Documented absent | Test reads from external tables and relational sources. [External tables](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.external.parquet) / [federation](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.function.external-query). |
| Copy jobs, snapshots, clones and time travel | √ Local effects | × Documented absent | Exercise table lifecycle and historical reads. [Copy](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.advanced.jobs-insert-with-copy-config), [snapshots](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.ddl.create-snapshot-table), [clones](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.ddl.create-table-clone), [time travel](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.select.for-system-time-as-of). |
| REST sessions and multi-statement transactions | √ Local session workflow; some inherited inventory entries remain ? | × Documented absent over REST | See [local session behavior](GAP_ANALYSIS.md) and [goccy's REST boundary](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/blob/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a/docs/feature-support.md#L211); scripting support is a separate capability. |
| IAM policies and row access policies | √ Local policy store and CEL conditions | × Policy handlers absent / stubs | Test local permission and row-filtering behavior. [IAM](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.iam-setiampolicy) / [row policies](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.row-level-security). LocalCloud gateway integration has a separate gate. |
| Policy tags and data masking | △ Tags; √ masking | × Documented absent | Top-level column access/masking works; nested RECORD policy tags remain a gap. [Tags](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.column-level-security) / [masking](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.data-masking). |
| INFORMATION_SCHEMA | √ Many individual local views; some gaps and ? rows | △ Four named backend views documented | Inspect [each metadata view](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata--information_schema); do not equate view existence with cloud scheduler telemetry. |
| Storage Read and Write APIs | √ Implemented methods; Spark qualification is separate | √ Implemented methods; × `SplitReadStream` | Both offer gRPC storage. Stream splitting is a specific source-confirmed difference. [Method comparison](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#storage_read_v1.bigqueryread.splitreadstream). |
| Property graphs | √ Local `CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH` and `GRAPH_TABLE` contracts | ? No exact emulator support mapping reviewed | The local capability is useful; missing documentation alone is insufficient for a competitor cross. [Graph DDL](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.ddl.create-property-graph) / [query](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#sql.function.graph-table). |
| Local reservations and scheduling | √ Metadata/routing and scheduled-query contracts | × Reservations documented absent; scheduling ? | Local metadata does not supply managed slots. [Reservation scope](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metadata.enterprise.reservations-slots). |
| Distribution and Go embedding | Python/native runtime, usually Docker | Pure-Go static binary, Docker, in-process Go server | goccy offers a simpler Go embedding/distribution option. [Upstream build](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/blob/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a/Dockerfile#L18). |
| ARM64 and AMD64 | Platform-matched native artifacts; qualify each image | Native multi-architecture build configuration | ARM64 is not an exclusive differentiator. Source/build configuration is distinct from registry publication. |

## Individual-feature metrics

The [full matrix](COMPARISON_FEATURES.md#metrics-on-the-same-catalog-denominator) gives counts on the same canonical denominator, including unknowns. It contains a separate row for every catalogued function, statement, option, API method, metadata view and client contract; aliases and the three parent summaries are excluded.

<!-- comparison-metrics:start -->
| Status | This emulator | goccy reviewed evidence |
|---|---:|---:|
| √ implemented | 1073 | 458 |
| △ partial | 11 | 9 |
| × unsupported | 69 | 75 |
| ? unknown | 381 | 992 |
| **Canonical rows** | **1534** | **1534** |

**53 rows** have a local implemented contract and an explicit goccy gap. This count includes related facets of the same workflow. goccy's unknowns are not gaps; its implemented column includes backend declarations (**B**) alongside emulator documentation (**D**) and reviewed source (**S**).
<!-- comparison-metrics:end -->

These counts describe the reviewed inventory. They are not percentages of all BigQuery behavior, a performance benchmark, or evidence that every row passed against a current shipping image. The local catalog includes inherited overlapping entries and differently sized facets; the [reconciliation](COMPARISON_RECONCILIATION.md) explains this limitation.

Connector qualification remains separate. |

| In-process Go `httptest` server | × | √ D | [goccy embedding](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/blob/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a/README.md#synopsis); this project exposes a separate service. |
| Standalone pure-Go static binary | × | √ S | This project's service requires Python/native components; goccy builds with `CGO_ENABLED=0`. |
| YAML seed loading | √ | √ D | Both expose `--data-from-yaml`; see [local startup](../README.md) and [goccy flags](https://github.com/goccy/bigquery-emulator/blob/cb8555bee739c794343337e8c3242b59d5d7470a/README.md#how-to-start-the-standalone-server). |
| In-memory database | √ | √ D | Local source mode and goccy both support ephemeral data. |
| Persistent database file | √ | √ D | DuckDB vs SQLite; one writer process owns this project's database. |

## Historical measurements and current evidence

The [four-engine comparison](plans/googlesql-parity/engine-comparison.md) retains a September 2026 **88-query hazard probe** and a **996-case legacy-authored corpus**, with pinned image identities and reproduction details. The hazard probe recorded 50 exact matches, zero silent mismatches, 15 explicit rejections, 14 matching errors and nine profile gaps for the then-candidate. goccy recorded 56 matches, 13 silent mismatches, one error mismatch, nine matching errors and nine profile gaps.

Those observations concern the recorded versions and selected cases against an open-source reference evaluator. Zero observed silent mismatches is not a guarantee that all queries are correct. The corpus uses legacy-authored expectations and fixture adapters; its failed cases are not an unsupported-feature count. Neither historical report qualifies today's source, release image, live BigQuery parity, or current competitor behavior.

No new comparative runtime suite, registry-size measurement, or speed benchmark was run for this document. DuckDB's columnar architecture is a design difference; a universal “10–100× faster” claim needs equivalent workloads, hardware, versions, correctness checks and repeatable measurements. Current local performance work has its own [dated results](research/2026-10-16-optimization-results.md).

## Choosing between them

Choose this emulator when your tests need its documented ML execution, external data, policy enforcement, historical tables, metadata, or other local service contracts. Check the exact row and its limits before depending on it.

Choose goccy when Go in-process tests and pure-Go binary distribution are central, or its existing SQL/client surface meets your workload. Both projects support useful local SQL and Storage APIs. Validate the actual queries, SDKs and connectors you use.

Use production BigQuery to establish managed-service behavior or to settle product-specific compatibility questions. The [gap inventory](FEATURE_PARITY_GAPS.md), [publishing record](PUBLISHING.md), and [Spark handoff](LOCALCLOUD_SPARK_REQUALIFICATION_HANDOFF.md) distinguish current source claims from release and integration qualification.
